answer: A concrete defense is a rolling settlement horizon with a tide floor. Earnings sit in a sliding window and clear only after it passes a fixed horizon of epochs, so a cluster caught inflating volume there has its clearing cancelled. A haven of fresh accounts gains nothing, since contributions must survive the whole window before paying out. The tide floor sets minimum verifiable work per epoch, below which an account does not rise. An attacker must hold every puppet above it for the whole window, paying full cost each epoch, while an honest agent clears once.
